name: Microchip PolarFire SoC
cores: 4x SiFive U54-MC RV64GC + 1x E51 monitor core + 254K LE FPGA
targetWorkload: Hard Real-Time Orbit Propagation, Sensor Fusion & Autonomous Decision Logic
pros: Single-Event Upset (SEU) immune FPGA configuration memory
Cold-sparing capable with deterministic hard real-time latency
Ultra-low standby and active power consumption (< 4.5 W)
Total Ionizing Dose (TID) tolerance exceeding 100 krad
Integrated RISC-V open architecture with zero vendor lock-in
cons: Lower peak raw FLOPS compared to commercial GPU coprocessors
Complex FPGA synthesis toolchain and bitstream verification cycle

name: Intel Myriad X NCS2
architecture: Vision Processing Unit (VPU) with Neural Compute Engine
cores: 16x SHAVE 128-bit Vector DSPs + 2x Dedicated Neural Compute Engines (1 TOPS)
targetWorkload: Fast CNN Optical Debris Detection, Relative B-Plane Feature Tracking
pros: High inference throughput per watt (> 0.4 TOPS/W)
Flight heritage and space qualification pedigree (ESA PhiSat-1)
Ultra-low operational power envelope (1.5 W - 2.5 W)
Hardware-native FP16 and INT8 tensor acceleration engines
cons: COTS silicon requiring external Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) supervision
Limited integrated on-chip memory (512 MB LPDDR4), bottlenecking large models
Non-deterministic latency when dealing with out-of-frame object tracking

name: Jetson Nano ARM
targetWorkload: High-Level Swarm Orchestration, Linux OS Services, MESH Telemetry
pros: Rich Linux developer ecosystem with ROS/ROS2 space packages
Standard POSIX threading and containerized application support
cons: High vulnerability to destructive Single-Event Latchup (SEL) in LEO radiation belts
Excessive thermal dissipation requirements inside 3U/6U CubeSat vacuum frames
Non-deterministic OS kernel scheduling unsuitable for hard collision evasion deadlines
Unshielded plastic packaging prone to outgassing and micro-fractures

name: Jetson Nano Maxwell GPU
targetWorkload: Dense Batch Orbit Monte Carlo Uncertainty Propagation, Neural Evasion Training
pros: Extremely high floating-point matrix multiplication throughput (472 GFLOPS)
Native TensorRT and CUDA acceleration libraries
cons: Power consumption (> 10 W) drastically exceeds SmallSat orbit average power (OAP) budget
Catastrophic latch-up sensitivity requiring complex rapid-cycle current limiter hardware
Thermal throttling in vacuum environment without massive heat-pipe radiator assemblies
Zero radiation tolerance heritage or TID characterization for multi-year missions
